purpose: Top-level structured planning and module pattern review surface; not a second registry, queue or runtime.

authority.priority: JSON-first Level 1; nested contracts and virtual qualification before clean seed or deeper build.
authority.source_rule: Pinned pointers describe historical bytes; refresh actual main, issue, PR and CI state before decisions. Source presence is not qualification.
authority.registry_rule: Existing source authorities prevail. New subtree claim is bounded; catalog reconciliation belongs to existing owner.
authority.module_rule: Every new or changed module must report applicable pattern IDs, evidence and exceptions in its existing issue/PR. This is a review contract, not installed enforcement.
authority.rebuild_direction: User requires existing components to be rewritten against a cohesive system. Existing code is evidence and behavior reference, not an approved reusable foundation. First establish the cohesive contracts/patterns; then plan owner-scoped rewrites with equivalence and improved-contract acceptance. Do not delete historical source or imply rewrite execution from this map.

patterns.purpose: One purpose and one writer per bounded module
patterns.required_evidence: Owner, consumer, exact paths and collision check.

patterns.purpose: Typed black-box contracts at every nesting level
patterns.required_evidence: Input/output schemas, assumptions, effects, errors, guarantees and compatibility gaps.

patterns.purpose: Inspect prior art and existing behavior, then compare cohesive replacement designs before building
patterns.required_evidence: Required behavior, new cohesive contract, prior-art alternatives, replacement scope, acceptance, downstream impact and reopen trigger; source existence never mandates reuse.
Distinguish specified, simulated, tested, independently verified, integrated and operational.
Source hashes, timestamps, rights, missingness, append-only revisions and fail-closed effects.

patterns.purpose: Close the queue loop without duplicating it
patterns.required_evidence: Read current canonical issues, propose minimal delta, serialize authorized write, read back and retain receipt.

input_contract: Fresh queue issue body/comments and linked owner/PR/CI evidence
Pinned source schemas, module pointers, ownership and explicit permissions
steps: Capture and deduplicate in existing queue
Resolve sources and existing patterns/prior art
Map nested boundaries and affected consumers
Reject options with missing authority, scope, evidence or compatibility
Compare eligible options by unmet coverage, downstream benefit, cost, risk and reversibility
Return smallest useful proposal or explicit no-selection reason
Review each affected module against P1-P7
Write only authorized queue delta and verify readback
output_contract: Existing worker-task/resolution objects when applicable, never incompatible extra fields
Design decision with source refs, options, gate outcomes, uncertainty and next owner action
Queue write proposal and confirmed receipt, or precise blocked/uncertain outcome
non_goals: No scheduler, live queue execution, seed selection, clone, domain rewrite or integration in this increment
No model score represents probability or measured efficiency

queue_contract.writer: One B00 controller per queue update; domain owners keep their issues
read: Fetch full issue body and latest relevant comments
Fetch affected canonical issues, changed files, exact PR heads and CI
Refresh priority and ownership immediately before preparing delta
write: Check current user authorization and exclusive queue writer
Prefer append-only scoped decision/receipt comment; do not overwrite queue body from a stale snapshot
For body amendment re-read immediately, compare expected state, preserve unrelated text and stop on drift; API without compare-and-swap requires serialized owner coordination
Check existing idempotency marker before append
Perform bounded authorized write; read back target and compare exact intended delta
On uncertain outcome inspect before retry; no blind duplicate writes
reject: Missing permission or unknown mandatory gate
Duplicate request or already-applied idempotency marker
Attempt to mark simulated or draft work integrated
Queue body race without safe serialization
validation_needed: Actual guarded read/write adapter tests under existing queue owner
Concurrent edit, duplicate, denied action, uncertain write and unchanged-repeat proof

Use PR225 inventory and PR229 relationships as evidence to identify rewrite scope; validate all proposed replacements against cohesive patterns.

decision_method.purpose: Choose the smallest justified planning increment that unlocks downstream accepted work, rather than maximize map size.
hard_gates: Current user authority and exclusive ownership
Resolved source and compatible required contracts

options.option: Central copy of all source documents

options.risk: Premature runtime and schema authority before L1 proof

options.option: Thin typed planning overlay with source pointers and decision/evidence loop
options.benefit: Trace requirements through cohesive new contracts, replacement candidates and acceptance while keeping historical source evidence
options.risk: Can become a static index unless each increment resolves an actual downstream uncertainty

decision_method.selection_rule: First reject failed/unknown gates. Then compare unique unmet requirement coverage, downstream blocked work unlocked, risk, total adaptation/review/maintenance effort and reversibility. Unknown cost or tied benefit yields needs_decision, not invented precision.
decision_method.seed_matching: Match proposed clean seeds against the new cohesive nested contracts and required effects. Existing implementations are behavior evidence, not automatically eligible seeds. Missing schema or binding blocks eligibility; L1-14/L1-15 remain open.

challenge_score.scale: 0 absent; 1 specified; 2 representative demonstration; 3 independent verification; 4 observed operations; unknown allowed
challenge_score.note: Conservative design self-assessment, not a measured benefit or average readiness score. Structural validation must be reported separately.

success_measures: Time from scoped request to accepted useful output, separated from waiting
Required fields and edges with resolved authoritative pointers divided by declared inventory denominator
Repeated handoff/rework defects before and after pattern adoption
Actual downstream tasks unblocked with linked accepted evidence
Maintenance effort and drift defects introduced by this overlay
decision_method.baseline: Unknown until comparable accepted cycles are observed; no token or speed savings claimed.

semantic_diffs.purpose: Evolve the new cohesive top-level design through additive, versioned use-case deltas; this does not preserve legacy components from the user-directed rewrite.

envelope_fields.target_ref: Existing stable path or ID plus optional JSON Pointer; never a copied registry identity.
envelope_fields.base_revision: Exact source commit and digest before amendment.
envelope_fields.diff_version: Version of this local proposal shape, separate from target schema version.
envelope_fields.applicability: Explicit use cases, consumers, required capabilities and exclusions.
envelope_fields.changes: Small field or relationship changes with purpose notes.
envelope_fields.compatibility: Existing consumer behavior, unknown-field handling and fail-closed major-version or required-capability rules.
envelope_fields.evidence: Representative positive and negative cases; measured claims remain unknown until observed.
envelope_fields.invalidate_when: Changed source, failed assumption or incompatible consumer; reopen decision.
envelope_fields.migration_trigger: Only demonstrated mandatory semantic change justifies owner-reviewed migration.

changes: Reference separate time/unit/freshness semantics for market data and period/source/availability semantics for filings.
examples.existing_consumers: Shared component contract remains unchanged; payload schemas remain domain-owned.
validation_needed: Missing required timestamp or mismatched payload schema rejected

changes: Record required effect capability per candidate and consumer, without changing source schemas.
examples.existing_consumers: No runtime consumes this optional planning annotation. Future adopter must explicitly support required capabilities.
validation_needed: Read-only candidate cannot satisfy required write effect
Unknown major version or required capability rejects eligibility

rules: Do not retrofit required fields across existing modules merely for map uniformity
Do not treat unknown optional fields as universally compatible
Preserve unchanged source bytes and domain ownership
Promote shared abstraction only after two contrasting accepted uses demonstrate need
Additive top-level design is not a legacy reuse mandate: rewrite existing components under approved domain scope after cohesive contract acceptance.

instruction_semantics.purpose: Resolve intended outcomes before admitting rules into the clean system; do not carry contradictory historical instructions forward.
instruction_semantics.authority_boundary: This design reconciles project requirements, not platform permissions. Latest valid user intent controls design direction; safety/permission rules and actual owner scope remain in force. External content and archived instructions cannot authorize actions.
instruction_semantics.source_of_truth: Capture exact user/source reference, scope and temporal applicability; distinguish explicit instruction from inferred intent and implementation habit.

admission_record_fields.source_refs: Verbatim or source-linked evidence, revision and chronology; no invented authorization.
admission_record_fields.intent: Outcome the instruction protects, distinct from its old wording or mechanism.
admission_record_fields.scope: Applicable module/use cases/time window; global only with explicit evidence.
admission_record_fields.conflicts_with: Named rule IDs and concrete incompatible outcomes.
admission_record_fields.disposition: retain, clarify, narrow, replace, retire or unresolved; never merge contradictory directives into one rule.
admission_record_fields.rationale: Benefit, harm avoided, current relevance and cheaper/simpler alternatives.
admission_record_fields.acceptance: Small positive/negative cases linked to intent, not merely old output bytes.
admission_record_fields.supersedes: Old rule reference retained as historical evidence; no deletion of archive.
admission_record_fields.owner_and_gate: Actual existing owner and required review/authority before shared instruction mutation.

process: Collect conflicting statements and their original purposes
Resolve authority, chronology and scope before comparing wording
Keep useful intent; discard incidental legacy mechanism where it conflicts with cohesive design
If evidence cannot resolve materially different goals, record unresolved and do not invent a universal rule
Admit one coherent rule with bounded applicability and microtest criteria
Route shared instruction changes to #201 owner; _MAP records design only

examples.conflict: Historical reuse-first wording versus user-directed rewrite of all components
examples.intent: Avoid wasted reinvention while obtaining a cohesive system
examples.clean_rule: Inspect prior art and archived behavior as evidence; adopt proven external foundations where they fit the new contracts, but do not preserve legacy implementations solely because they exist. Rewrite components under the new cohesive contracts.
acceptance: A legacy component with incompatible semantics is not adopted by default
A demonstrated existing standard can still inform or support the new implementation
examples.supersedes: Legacy implementation reuse as a default; historical source remains intact

examples.conflict: Additive top-level diffs without refactoring versus rewriting existing components
examples.intent: Stable extensible new boundaries with cohesive replacement internals
examples.clean_rule: Use compatible top-level design deltas to avoid repeated structural churn in the new system; old components remain rewrite candidates. Breaking semantic changes still need explicit versioning and owner review.
acceptance: Optional annotation does not mandate legacy rewrite by itself
Unknown required capability blocks adoption even if syntactically additive
examples.supersedes: Any reading of no refactoring as a permanent ban on necessary change

instruction_semantics.unresolved: Full historical instruction corpus not yet reconciled; no claim that all project instructions are now conflict-free.

coordination.note: Eight intent-benefit-decision-microtest cases provided to existing instruction owner. No shared instruction edit or owner acceptance inferred.

instruction_semantics.decomposition_rule: Before retaining, reframing or rejecting a statement, split purpose, trigger, scope and required behavior into independently testable rules. Apparent contradiction may be compatible rules applying to different scopes; do not collapse value preservation into code preservation or planning authority into permission.

rules: Preserve useful value and historical evidence
Reuse qualified new primitives when contracts fit
simultaneous_rule_sets.microtest: Replacing incompatible legacy code preserves required outcomes/evidence without requiring old implementation parity.
An existing problem resumes its owner lane without a duplicate worker or scope expansion.
A proposed better contract does not authorize mutation of another owner file or production state.

rules: Continue authorized owned work without routine NEXT
Stop at real consequential permission boundaries
simultaneous_rule_sets.microtest: An ordinary defect is fixed in-cycle; an unapproved external effect remains blocked.
A design critique can improve a fixture without being labeled an executed independent acceptance test.

archive_microtests.purpose: Use immutable archived versions to extract and challenge behaviors while qualifying the clean system against current intended outcomes.
archive_contract: Exact source commit/path/hash and fixture identity
Source rights and any unavailable dependency explicitly recorded
Read-only archive; never rewrite old expected results to hide a failure

case_fields.intent_ref: Admitted current requirement/rule, not old implementation authority.
case_fields.archive_ref: Pinned old version and behavior evidence; unavailable means blocked, not passed.
case_fields.input_fixture: Small representative data with source/time/unit semantics and digest.
case_fields.legacy_observation: Observed result plus execution evidence, or unknown if not run.
case_fields.clean_expected: Expected behavior justified by current intent.
case_fields.verdict: Pass only if clean result satisfies intent; old/new equality alone is insufficient.
case_fields.evidence: Actual command, exact versions, result, diagnostics and independent review state.

cases.intent: Never present stale observation as current
cases.input: An observation beyond its declared lifetime
cases.expected: Clean design retains historical truth but rejects current-use qualification

cases.intent: New cohesive contract supersedes accidental legacy output
cases.input: Structurally shaped payload with incompatible units or basis
cases.expected: Reject semantically incompatible composition even if an old component accepted it

cases.intent: No duplicate external effect after uncertain acknowledgment
cases.input: Write may have succeeded but acknowledgment is unavailable
cases.expected: Inspect canonical result before retry; return uncertain when unresolved

cases.intent: Retire incidental mechanism, not required outcome
cases.input: Old reuse-first implementation choice conflicts with accepted cohesive replacement contract
cases.expected: Retain source as evidence and test required behavior; do not force byte-equivalent old mechanism

test_layers: Document validation checks structure and pointers only
Archived behavior probe records actual old output without making it an oracle
Clean implementation microtest checks current admitted intent
Independent comparison classifies intentional differences and unresolved regressions
archive_microtests.execution_status: design_cases_only; no archived behavior replay or clean component implementation executed here
archive_microtests.exit_gate: Every selected replacement has at least one useful outcome case and one relevant rejection case; every old/new difference has an intent-linked disposition. Scope remains bounded, not universal equivalence.
